mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies along the Military Ridge State Trail with an air quality index of 56.
The Public Works Department reminds residents that Pellitteri Waste Systems handles all residential refuse and recycling. You can find collection maps and the 2026 calendar on the city website.
Enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run. Tomorrow, you can check out yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by a busy week of trivia nights and performances starting Tuesday.
Regarding the weekly report, on October 23, officers made contact with two juveniles riding eMotos, leading to citations for their parents for permitting the use of prohibited motor vehicles.
Enjoy a scoop of today's flavor, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The shop is currently open until 10:00 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
